fields.label: Type d'étude
fields.quote: We compare the different permutations of Bio-SIEVE to a series of zero-shot baselines and trained models using the standard approach on the review subset.

fields.label: Données
fields.quote: Table 1: Number of samples in each split of the Instruct Cochrane dataset.

fields.label: Modèles
fields.value: Modèles entraînés pendant 8 époques, sélection du meilleur modèle sur l’ensemble safety-first.
fields.quote: Each model was trained for 8 epochs and the best model on the safety-first set was selected for comparison.

fields.label: Résultats
fields.quote: Our best performing model, Guanaco7B (Single), achieved 0.82 accuracy on the Test Set. By comparison, ChatGPT achieved 0.6 accuracy.

fields.label: Limites
fields.value: Limitation : les raisons d'exclusion générées par Bio-SIEVE-Multi sont moins bonnes que celles de ChatGPT.
fields.quote: Namely, that the exclusion reasons generated by our Bio-SIEVE-Multi variants were outperformed by ChatGPT.
